name: Image Depth Parallax
description: Photogrammetry and image relief agent: converts 2D images and PNG files into 3D volumetric meshes with depth estimation, Sobel normals, and specular highlights.
capabilities: 3D relief reconstruction from RGBA bytes of any image or PNG
Real-time surface normal calculation using bidirectional Sobel filters
Bilateral anterior and posterior extrusion with radial correction
High-power specular lighting to enhance texture and detail
Automatic archiving into the hierarchical taxonomic catalog
